data.title: 吹雪 · 摇晃高脚杯的组长拉拢宣言
data.action: 优雅斜倚在法式天鹅绒贵妃榻上，单手摇晃波尔多红酒杯，黑色卷发修饰出冷艳锁骨，霸道地邀请你加入吹雪组
data.location: Z市高级公寓顶层客厅天鹅绒贵妃榻上
data.lighting: 落地窗外Z市夜景的璀璨灯海，与大理石茶几上香薰蜡烛的摇曳光影，在墨绿天鹅绒睡裙上衬出极致贵气
data.mood: 女王傲岸、高贵冷艳、渴望被认可的深层好胜心
data.description: 高级公寓顶层的奢华起居室。B级第1位‘地狱吹雪’卸下白日的皮草大衣，换上一袭墨绿天鹅绒深V高贵吊带睡袍。她斜倚在定制的法式贵妃榻上，一条修长的大腿从开叉处舒展，修长的玉指摇曳着红酒杯，墨绿色的短发自然卷曲在雪白的香肩旁。她抬眸俯视着你，红唇轻扬，带着女王般不容拒绝的命令口吻——「既然今晚来到了我的私人领域……那就把字签了吧。成为吹雪组的一员，我可以在英雄协会中为你提供一切庇护与荣誉……别让我等太久哦。」
data.promptProse: Reclining regally on a velvet chaise lounge inside her high-rise penthouse suite at midnight, Fubuki wears a plunging emerald-green crushed velvet boudoir gown with a high side slit. Swirling a glass of red wine with a commanding smirk, she is framed by flickering table candlelight and the glittering city skyline beyond tall glass windows.
data.animaCaption: Reclining regally on a velvet chaise lounge in a plunging emerald crushed-velvet slip gown with a thigh-high slit, she swirls a glass of red wine and fixes the viewer with an imperious, inviting smirk. Flickering candlelight on the marble table meets the glittering midnight city skyline.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an emerald-green crushed velvet plunge boudoir gown tailored to her hourglass waist with a daring décolletage and high-leg side slit.
